title: Nitrogen gave no clear summer slope contrast in four British butterfly samples in 1986-2012
abstract: We tested whether summer-temperature slopes of butterfly indices differed with nitrogen deposition and larval host-plant nitrogen. We joined a published UK Butterfly Monitoring Scheme panel to GHCN-CAMS seasonal temperatures. Four models used 356,011 records in southern England and in northern England, Wales and Scotland in 1986-1998 and 1999-2012. Site-year, site-species and regional species-year effects controlled shared survey conditions and regional change. All four main intervals included zero after correction for four tests. These results do not establish that nitrogen has no effect. Static 1995-97 deposition, coarse weather, selected transects, uncertain host traits and species-specific detection limit inference. The package includes all model inputs, source hashes, code, checks and a figure.
